SELECT A.BUSI_DATE busiDate, A.MARKET_CODE marketCode, A.IS_HOLIDAY isHoliday, A.STATUS status, A.DEPT_CODE deptCode FROM CHB_MKT_HOLIDAY A
A.BUSI_DATE >= STR_TO_DATE(#{start},'%Y-%m-%d')
AND A.BUSI_DATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{end},'%Y-%m-%d')
AND A.MARKET_CODE = #{marketCalendarType}
ORDER BY A.BUSI_DATE

SELECT A.BUSI_DATE busiDate, A.MARKET_CODE marketCode, A.IS_HOLIDAY isHoliday, A.STATUS status, A.DEPT_CODE deptCode FROM CHB_MKT_HOLIDAY A
A.BUSI_DATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{holidayDate},'%Y-%m-%d') AND A.MARKET_CODE = #{marketCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND A.STATUS = 'E'

select deadline.* from( SELECT LIMIT num, A.BUSI_DATE busiDate, A.MARKET_CODE marketCode, A.IS_HOLIDAY isHoliday, A.STATUS status, A.DEPT_CODE deptCode FROM CHB_MKT_HOLIDAY A
A.BUSI_DATE < STR_TO_DATE(#{holidayDate},'%Y-%m-%d')
A.BUSI_DATE > STR_TO_DATE(#{holidayDate},'%Y-%m-%d')
AND A.MARKET_CODE = #{marketCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND A.STATUS = 'E' AND A.IS_HOLIDAY = '1'
order by A.BUSI_DATE desc
order by A.BUSI_DATE asc
)deadline where num = #{days,jdbcType=INTEGER}

select deadline.* from( SELECT LIMIT num, A.BUSI_DATE busiDate, A.MARKET_CODE marketCode, A.IS_HOLIDAY isHoliday, A.STATUS status, A.DEPT_CODE deptCode FROM CHB_MKT_HOLIDAY A
A.BUSI_DATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{holidayDate},'%Y-%m-%d')
A.BUSI_DATE >= STR_TO_DATE(#{holidayDate},'%Y-%m-%d')
AND A.MARKET_CODE = #{marketCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND A.STATUS = 'E' AND A.IS_HOLIDAY = '1'
order by A.BUSI_DATE desc
order by A.BUSI_DATE asc
)deadline where num = 1
